name: Terror Whispers

boost.name: The Silver Key
effect: As an action, you may spend 2 Gauge. If you do, Strike. The opponent must defend with a Wild Swing.
HIT: Put a card from your discard into your Dreamlands.

name: Out Of Mind

boost.name: Slipping Away
effect: When you place a card into your Dreamlands, you may spend 1 Force. If you do, Move 1.
HIT: Add a card from your Dreamlands to your Gauge. If you did, gain Power equal to that card's Power, to a maximum of +5. Otherwise, add all cards in your hand to your Gauge, then draw 3 cards.

name: Hollow Space

boost.name: Dark Reflections
effect: Name a card. The opponent discards a copy of that card, or reveals a hand without any. Put any discarded cards into your Dreamlands.
Attacks at Range 1 do not hit you.

name: Dark Thoughts

boost.name: Spiraling Descent
effect: If a card is in your Dreamlands, the opponent cannot Boost using a copy of that card, and copies of that card are invalid for the opponent.
HIT: The opponent discards a card at random. If a card was discarded, you may put it into your Dreamlands.

name: Shadow Chorus

boost.name: Whispers In The Dark
effect: Draw a card, then perform the Instant Boost effect of a card in your Dreamlands, ignoring its Force cost.
When you reveal this attack, it becomes a copy of a card in your Dreamlands (if you have one). You must pay any costs required to play the card. This card cannot be placed into your Dreamlands.

name: Unknown Khadath

boost.name: Dream Telling
effect: BEFORE: Gain Power equal to the Power of a card in your Dreamlands, to a maximum of +5.
AFTER: Add this card to your Gauge.
BEFORE: Place the opponent's attack into your Dreamlands and add this card to your Gauge. End the Strike.

name: Call Of The Dreamlands

boost.name: The Sleeper Awakes
effect: Cards enter your Dreamlands facedown. Reveal them when they are referenced by a card effect.
HIT: Both players reveal their hands. For each Special and Ultra Attack revealed, +1 Power.
